title: T pentacube tiling witness: 3x11x30
purpose: constructive witness that the Macro graph on this cross-section is cyclic (closed macro walk of length z through state 0); refutes acyclicity claims in the superseded t_3xn_cyclicity_criterion revision

conventions.state_packing: state = l0 | (l1 << NCELLS); slot 2 is always 0 because every node is a post-shift state
conventions.rotations: proper rotations only (signed permutation matrices, det=+1)
conventions.window_coords: edge k fill pieces are given relative to layer k: (x, y, dz), dz in {0,1,2}; absolute cell = (x, y, k+dz)
conventions.edge_legality_definition: pieces of edge k must (i) each be congruent to the piece geometry under proper rotation, (ii) be pairwise disjoint, (iii) avoid all cells occupied by state s_k, (iv) complete slot 0 of s_k, and their slot-1/slot-2 occupancy added to s_k's L1/L2 must equal s_{k+1}'s L0/L1 after shift
conventions.semantics_note: machine-pinned identifier; the prose fields below are human-readable restatements of the same pinned semantics and are not parsed by checkers
